definition: For each EDGAR merger-filing candidate with a mapped symbol, measure the largest NYSE-calendar consecutive close-to-close jump in the 180 days ending on the first merger-form proxy date. Proxy date is usually after the true announcement; this is a filing-backed lower/upper hybrid bound on deals that printed a large immediate-style move, not a verified announcement-date registry.
notes: candidate_symbols mapping is imperfect; some tickers are wrong or post-event reincarnations.
A ≥20% jump before a DEFM14A/SC14D9 can be the announcement print, a rumor print, or unrelated.
Annual EDGAR-with-symbol counts already exceed 20 in every year 2013–2024 in this file.
